name: Park Hyatt Beaver Creek Resort and Spa
positioning: Park Hyatt resort and spa in Beaver Creek Village, Colorado, steps from the ski lifts and the village ice rink
best_for: Skiers who want to be steps from the lifts and the ski school
Families wanting games, guided hikes and a heated outdoor pool

facts.text: Rooms are steps from the lifts, Beaver Creek Ski & Snowboard School, the village ice rink and the shops and restaurants of Beaver Creek Village.
Exhale Spa offers massages, facials and body treatments, plus access to the resort fitness classes.
The resort has an outdoor heated swimming pool.
8100 Mountainside has a heated patio with views of the ski base and valley.
Brass Bear Bar features a grand fireplace and a selection of cocktails and bar bites.
Fall Line Market is a 24-hour market stocked with salads, sandwiches, pastries, coffee and espresso.
The on-site ski rental and shop is inside the resort, between the ski slopes and the Village ice rink.
The One King Park Junior Suite has an electric fireplace that is functional for fall and winter seasons.
Rooms have Le Labo bath amenities.
The resort fee includes indoor and outdoor games including a family arcade, table tennis, cornhole and family board games.
The resort fee includes guided hikes on Beaver Creek Mountain.
Up to two dogs weighing up to 70 pounds each are welcome per room or suite, with a one-time nonrefundable $200 fee.

highlights.text: The renovation of the resort's guest rooms and suites is complete, with renovated rooms available for stays starting October 2025.
Brass Bear Bar has floor-to-ceiling views of the Beaver Creek mountains.
8100 Mountainside is named for the 8,100 ft. base elevation of Beaver Creek.
The pool area has five hot tubs and cabanas that can be reserved.
The resort holds seasonal culinary events including Chef's Table dining and a Raclette experience.

considerations.text: A daily resort fee of $60.00, subject to change, applies to each room.
The resort has partnered exclusively with SnowCountry for guest transportation to and from Eagle County Regional Airport.
WhataHotel notes peak winter rates during ski season.
